message:
## Vulnerability Digest

No newly reported vulnerability was verified as an exact match to the monitored products during the last 24 hours (2026-08-19 05:10 IST to 2026-08-20 05:10 IST).

Eight newly published vulnerabilities affect WordPress plugins. Because the product inventory lists WordPress but not installed plugins, they are included as possible matches needing review rather than confirmed findings.

### Possible matches needing review

**1. NGG Smart Image Search for WordPress**

- Affected product/component: NGG Smart Image Search before 4.0.0
- Issue: CVE-2026-73185
- Severity: Critical
- Description: An unauthenticated SQL injection vulnerability affects versions before 4.0.0.
- Relevance: Relevant only if this plugin is installed on a monitored WordPress site.
- Source: [Patchstack advisory](https://patchstack.com/database/wordpress/plugin/ngg-smart-image-search/vulnerability/wordpress-ngg-smart-image-search-plugin-4-0-0-sql-injection-vulnerability?_s_id=cve)

**2. Nikstore Core for WordPress**

- Affected product/component: Nikstore Core through 1.5
- Issue: CVE-2026-73388
- Severity: Critical
- Description: An unauthenticated SQL injection vulnerability affects versions through 1.5.
- Relevance: Relevant only if this plugin is installed on a monitored WordPress site.
- Source: [Patchstack advisory](https://patchstack.com/database/wordpress/plugin/nikstore-core/vulnerability/wordpress-nikstore-core-plugin-1-5-sql-injection-vulnerability?_s_id=cve)

**3. Simple File List for WordPress**

- Affected product/component: Simple File List through 6.3.11
- Issue: CVE-2026-16616
- Severity: High
- Description: An unauthenticated file-move action can expose arbitrary server files and relocate critical files, potentially enabling site takeover.
- Relevance: Relevant only if this plugin is installed on a monitored WordPress site.
- Source: [WPScan advisory](https://wpscan.com/vulnerability/9631c97e-42e5-43b0-8998-e106f474ffba)

**4. TranslatePress for WordPress**

- Affected product/component: TranslatePress through 3.2.5
- Issue: CVE-2026-75981
- Severity: High
- Description: An unauthenticated stored cross-site scripting flaw can turn crafted translation markers in comments into executable browser content.
- Relevance: Relevant only if this plugin is installed on a monitored WordPress site.
- Source: [Wordfence advisory](https://www.wordfence.com/threat-intel/vulnerabilities/id/fec48853-afa5-4310-be2e-e86c01ece227?source=cve)

**5. BBQ Pro for WordPress**

- Affected product/component: BBQ Pro through 3.9
- Issue: CVE-2026-73182
- Severity: High
- Description: An unauthenticated cross-site scripting vulnerability affects versions through 3.9.
- Relevance: Relevant only if this plugin is installed on a monitored WordPress site.
- Source: [Patchstack advisory](https://patchstack.com/database/wordpress/plugin/bbq-pro/vulnerability/wordpress-bbq-pro-plugin-3-9-cross-site-scripting-xss-vulnerability?_s_id=cve)

**6. WPS Bidouille for WordPress**

- Affected product/component: WPS Bidouille before 1.33.5
- Issue: CVE-2026-19782
- Severity: Moderate
- Description: An authenticated subscriber can retrieve the email addresses of all registered users because an AJAX action lacks authorization checks.
- Relevance: Relevant only if this plugin is installed on a monitored WordPress site.
- Source: [WPScan advisory](https://wpscan.com/vulnerability/8dabc48e-15ee-482c-be77-6ad6fb312a7a)

**7. JetEngine for WordPress**

- Affected product/component: JetEngine before 3.8.14
- Issue: CVE-2026-18202
- Severity: Moderate
- Description: Users allowed to upload files can upload unsanitized SVG content that executes JavaScript when opened.
- Relevance: Relevant only if this plugin is installed on a monitored WordPress site.
- Source: [WPScan advisory](https://wpscan.com/vulnerability/911d3b5a-0f03-4423-b4b0-84e588c323d8)

**8. EWWW Image Optimizer for WordPress**

- Affected product/component: EWWW Image Optimizer through 8.7.3
- Issue: CVE-2026-15446
- Severity: Moderate
- Description: A contributor-level user can inject stored cross-site scripting through a crafted lazy-load image attribute.
- Relevance: Relevant only if this plugin is installed on a monitored WordPress site.
- Source: [Wordfence advisory](https://www.wordfence.com/threat-intel/vulnerabilities/id/e8af1fdb-7fec-4bbe-937b-ee2e76cf5c5b?source=cve)

Immediate review is recommended to determine whether any of these plugins are deployed. Prioritize NGG Smart Image Search, Nikstore Core, and Simple File List if present. No other monitored-product finding was verified as newly reported inside the window.
